area_note: PicoRV32 is optimized for minimum area. The core's entire state (registers + control) is very small. A 16-word hardware operand buffer is ~512 flops, which represents a massive area increase for a core whose register file is only 1024 flops.
constraints: The PCPI coprocessor interface CANNOT access memory. It has no memory address or data signals.
A custom PCPI instruction takes exactly two 32-bit register inputs (pcpi_rs1, pcpi_rs2) and returns exactly one 32-bit register output (pcpi_rd).
To process memory data, the core must execute explicit load instructions to fetch data into registers, then pass those registers to PCPI.
The PCPI interface is blocking; asserting pcpi_wait stalls the main CPU until pcpi_ready is asserted.
coprocessor_result: 32 bits returned per instruction via pcpi_rd, optionally written to the destination register if pcpi_wr is asserted.
custom_opcode_space: Any opcode that is not decoded by the base ISA triggers the PCPI coprocessor interface if WITH_PCPI is enabled (e.g., custom-0 through custom-3, excluding some 0x0B space used for IRQs).
evidence: picorv32.v: `parameter COMPRESSED_ISA`, `ENABLE_MUL` show base RV32I with optional extensions.
picorv32.v: `cpu_state_fetch`, `cpu_state_ld_rs1`, `cpu_state_exec` define a multi-cycle state machine.
picorv32.v: PCPI ports (`pcpi_valid`, `pcpi_insn`, `pcpi_rs1`, `pcpi_rs2`, `pcpi_wr`, `pcpi_rd`) show only register-level data exchange.
picorv32.v: `instr_trap` falls back to PCPI, meaning any unused opcode goes to the coprocessor.
existing_units: Multiplier (sequential shift-and-add unless ENABLE_FAST_MUL is set, which uses a DSP array)
Shifter (sequential or single-cycle depending on BARREL_SHIFTER)
isa: RV32I (with parameterized support for M, C, and custom IRQs)
memory_interface: Native 32-bit valid/ready memory interface (with adapters for AXI4-Lite/Wishbone).
microarchitecture: Multi-cycle non-pipelined state machine (Fetch -> Decode/LD_RS1 -> Exec -> Mem).
name: PicoRV32
register_file: 32 x 32-bit registers (optionally 16). Contains 2 read ports (if ENABLE_REGS_DUALPORT=1) and 1 write port.
